claimAssessments.claim: 先生 is a respectful title for teachers and also certain experts/professionals.
claimAssessments.rationale: The dictionary lists teachers/instructors and specialists such as physicians, and records the honorific address use.

claimAssessments.claim: It follows a surname or is used alone as a vocative.
claimAssessments.rationale: The lexicon supports title/address functions but not all sentence patterns in the article.

claimAssessments.claim: It can substitute for third-person pronouns when referring to a known person.
claimAssessments.rationale: No primary syntax/pragmatics source was located for the substitution claim.

claimAssessments.claim: It is normally inappropriate to call oneself 先生.
claimAssessments.rationale: The consulted dictionary does not discuss self-reference; the broad rule remains unverified.

consultedSources.publisher: 小学館; コトバンク
consultedSources.locator: 精選版 日本国語大辞典, senses ③–⑥, lines 54–63: expert/professional, teacher, honorific address, and historical examples.
consultedSources.use: Fuente consultada para el seguimiento; no se considera respaldo completo si el locator no cubre el reclamo.

semanticReview.method: Se reabrió la revisión anterior y se cotejaron por separado las afirmaciones materiales del artículo con fuentes primarias públicas gratuitas y sus localizadores. La revisión previa y el hash del artículo se cotejaron contra el estado compartido del coordinador.
findings: It follows a surname or is used alone as a vocative. The lexicon supports title/address functions but not all sentence patterns in the article.
It can substitute for third-person pronouns when referring to a known person. No primary syntax/pragmatics source was located for the substitution claim.
It is normally inappropriate to call oneself 先生. The consulted dictionary does not discuss self-reference; the broad rule remains unverified.
limitations: Las fuentes localizadas respaldan solo una parte del contenido o no coinciden con todos los ejemplos y generalizaciones; por eso claimsVerified=0 para la certificación completa.
